summary: @ornikar/prettier-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Prettier configuration, which requires no code execution at install time. Its `package.json` declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a rotating-string-array cipher (functions `WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`, `hc1jfK9`) and hex-mangled identifiers, so its behavior cannot be inspected statically. The alternate-runtime download exists to execute a payload that Node-based scanners cannot introspect; the payload's contents are unrelated to formatting configuration. Installing this package causes an opaque, obfuscated binary payload to run with the installer's shell privileges at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
